# Sprint 07 — Order buttons

**UI sprint.** Angular only (`llm-angular`). Not Route3. Do not edit `server/`.

The restaurant card answers “which place.” Wolt, 10bis, and Mishloha are a gray “Order via” line under Navigate and Call, so they do not look clickable. This sprint makes those apps real buttons, gives them a press, and fades the result list in once.

Deals and a menu are out of scope.
